drafted_at_note: hand-written fictional case, labels written by author, 2026-10-14

expected_items.title: Capture vendor GSTIN on receipts so they can claim input tax credit
expected_items.body: Rohit says the scanner reads amount and date but not the vendor's GSTIN, which they need on every bill to claim input tax credit (translation: we need the vendor GSTIN on every bill, otherwise we cannot claim input tax credit). Missing or wrong GSTINs mean lost credit, which is real money. He also wants a separate GSTIN column in the export for their accountant. This is the capability the renewal hinges on.
expected_items.quote: Hamein har bill pe vendor ka GSTIN chahiye, warna input tax credit claim nahi kar paate.

expected_items.title: Manual GSTIN spreadsheet costs Sneha's team two days every month end
expected_items.body: Today Sneha's team opens every bill at month end and copies the GSTIN into a spreadsheet by hand, which takes almost two days (translation: every month end my team builds an Excel, opening each bill and copying the GSTIN; it takes almost two days). This quantifies the cost of the missing GST capture.
expected_items.quote: Haan, main aur meri team har mahine end mein ek Excel banate hain. Har bill khol ke GSTIN copy karte hain. Almost do din lag jaate hain.

expected_items.title: CFO is weighing a local GST-aware tool at the March renewal
expected_items.body: Rohit disclosed that their CFO thinks they should buy a local tool that understands GST, and if nothing on GST lands before the March renewal the CFO will push to switch (translation: our CFO feels we should get a local tool that understands GST; renewal is in March). Rohit likes the product but cannot defend it without GST support. Concrete churn risk with a date.
expected_items.quote: Humare CFO ko lag raha hai ki koi local tool lena chahiye jo GST samajhta ho.

expected_items.title: Android app logs users out daily and forces an OTP every morning
expected_items.body: Sneha reports the mobile app logs field users out every day, mostly on Android (Samsung and Redmi), so they re-enter an OTP each morning (translation: the app logs out every day, we have to enter an OTP every morning, the field team is very irritated). Sessions should last thirty days, so this looks like a bug. Field staff stop uploading receipts and dump them at month end, which undercuts the core value.
expected_items.quote: Yaar app roz logout ho jaata hai, har subah OTP daalna padta hai, field team bahut irritate hai.

expected_items.title: Arjun raises the logout bug with mobile today, update by Monday
expected_items.body: Arjun committed to talking to the mobile team the same day and giving Vandelay an update on the cause by Monday (translation: I will talk to the mobile team today and update you by Monday on what the issue is).
expected_items.quote: Main mobile team se aaj hi baat karta hoon aur Monday tak update deta hoon ki issue kya hai.

expected_items.title: Arjun escalates GSTIN capture and the export column to the product team
expected_items.body: In the closing recap Arjun took the GSTIN asks to product as his own action: GSTIN capture on receipts plus a separate GSTIN export column (translation: from my side, I will escalate GSTIN capture and the export column to the product team). Earlier he had said it would go to product and that he would escalate it with priority after hearing the CFO risk.
expected_items.quote: Mere side se: GSTIN capture aur export column product team ko escalate karunga

expected_items.title: Sneha sends twenty sample invoices from different vendors by Friday
expected_items.body: Sneha will share twenty sample invoices from different vendors by Friday so product has real GSTIN examples, including handwritten ones at Rohit's request (translation: I will send twenty sample invoices by Friday, from different vendors).
expected_items.quote: Haan, main Friday tak twenty sample invoices bhej dungi, alag alag vendors ke.

expected_items.title: Sneha sends the list of Android phone models hitting the logout bug
expected_items.body: Sneha does not know the exact Android versions behind the daily logout, mostly Samsung and Redmi, and offered to check and report back (translation: I don't know exactly, mostly Samsung and Redmi; I can check and tell you). Arjun's recap assigned it to her as the list of Android phone models, and she confirmed. It gives the mobile team what they need to reproduce the bug.
expected_items.quote: Exact nahi pata, mostly Samsung aur Redmi hain. Main check karke bata sakti hoon.
